messages:
Diego (SI Lead): Quick heads-up — AcmeHealth private deployment to Marketplace is blocked. After image import, long-lived gRPC streams between Redwood runtime and customer agent start stalling after ~30–60s. Suspect NIC driver/firmware mismatch on partner-supplied boxes. Need short architecture review + triage in 30m. Logs pasted below.

Priya (Customer Arch): Thanks Diego — attaching kernel logs from the node that reproduced it.

Priya (Customer Arch): ```
[ 3456.123456] igb: eth0 NIC Link is Up
[ 3456.223456] gRPC: stream stalled: queue depth 0 -> 1
[ 3456.323456] kernel: NAPI poll list is empty, soft lockup?
[ 3456.423456] igb 0000:03:00.0: firmware mismatch: v2.1 vs v2.3
```

Sam (Partner Eng): Noted. We saw similar failure mode with RDMA/offload options enabled on kernels >= 5.15 when firmware + driver are out of sync. Quick workaround: disable TSO/GSO/GRO offloads and turn off LRO on the NIC. If that stabilizes streams we can roll a tuned driver/firmware combo.

Kevin (Field Eng): Can confirm on a staging node — disabling offloads reduced stalls. Quick commands I used:

Kevin (Field Eng): ```bash
sudo ethtool -K eth0 tso off gso off gro off lro off
sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime
```

Ava (Solutions Eng): OK — two parallel asks: 1) can we get a short runbook update for customer to apply the ethtool workaround and a note in the marketplace image docs about recommended firmware versions; 2) can we route customer temporarily to the gateway-compat model variant to avoid long-lived streaming on the affected nodes while partner ships firmware patch.

Sam (Partner Eng): We can publish a firmware compatibility matrix by EOD. Also we can ship a hotfix driver next week. For immediate mitigation, Kevin's ethtool approach is fine. I'm going to prepare a manifest patch for the marketplace image to surface 'no-streams' as a capability flag and a fallback to gateway-compat.

marketplace-bot: Deployment manifest patch created: PR #682 (staged). CI passed: unit → image-scan → smoke. Waiting for manual apply.

Diego (SI Lead): Great. Ava — can you run the 30m sync and invite Priya + Sam + Kevin? Outcome: apply ethtool workaround, flip marketplace flag to gateway-compat, and schedule partner firmware rollout. Also add temporary healthcheck ramp for gRPC stream duration (drop if >45s) so we can auto-failover to gateway-compat.

Ava (Solutions Eng): On it. Scheduling 30m: meeting invite sent. Agenda: reproduce steps, apply workaround, patch manifest, telemetry checks. Priya — please confirm which nodes we should target first (prod or staging).

Priya (Customer Arch): Start with the three staging nodes (stg-1/2/3) — will then promote to canary prod if green.

Sam (Partner Eng): I'll post the compatibility matrix link in thread after PR merges. :thumbsup:

Kevin (Field Eng): Temporary runbook note:

Kevin (Field Eng): "If gRPC streams stall: 1) run ethtool commands; 2) restart redwood-runtime; 3) monitor 5m; 4) if still bad, set marketplace manifest flag gateway-compat and open partner-driver ticket."

Diego (SI Lead): Thanks team — let's treat as P2 delivery risk until firmware fix. Keep updates here after the sync. :pray:
